summary: Blast radius: removing the per-element --dry-run from preflight means 14 commands (artifacts store, export, gate install-hooks, gate promote, ingest plans/records/sessions, init, inventory sync, plugin sync, skills install, strategy promote, subject adopt, subject unadopt) now run the earlier elements before a state fault stops the batch (verified: subject adopt [valid, missing change, valid] -> exit 1 BATCH_INCOMPLETE /1, item 0 executed, item 2 skipped; 0.34 refused whole with exit 2). That is the brief's decided behaviour and the CHANGELOG lists it as an upgrade note; the checks do not exercise it for the other 13 commands (05 uses subject adopt only), and a failed element's own error.field is /<index> for most codes (FINDING_NOT_FOUND, SUBJECT_ADOPT_REFUSED), deeper (/1/operands) only where the child's error carried a document pointer.
